source.title: Gossamer Belt — firsthand disenchant into Dream Dust
source.author: Allakhazam (archived commenter; handle unknown)

quote: I disenchanted this and got a dream dust.
notes: One firsthand Classic-era item-specific disenchant; source explicitly reports one Gossamer Belt into one Dream Dust. Source disputes a listed 100% Greater Nether Essence reference; no invented other-material zeros.

source.title: Arcane Dust — Shattered Halls green-item disenchant report

notes: One firsthand Shattered Halls normal instance run, group of unspecified green item IDs and mix.
